answer: Map the interaction graph and discount dense coordination: treat each agent as a node and watch how value and attestations flow. Honest agents voyage across many independent counterparties, light as a sparrow; a sybil ring forms a tight ridge of mutually reinforcing edges. Scoring each node by how reciprocal and clustered its edges are lets the protocol cut payouts to coordinated clusters, so a hundred fakes that only attest each other collapse to about one share.
